text:
maria_cs: ProdBridge wants to onboard a custom NER model for insurance claims. They need PHI redaction, private deployment (VPC), and we need to run our safety/evals before commit. They mentioned possible renewal concerns if onboarding takes >4 weeks. Sharing intake doc and next steps.

raj_se: Quick clarifying q's — are they requesting fine-tuning on their labeled dataset or an adapter workflow? Also what's the target model size and expected TPS / sequence length distribution?

maria_cs: They'd prefer fine-tuning if needed — dataset ~150k labeled spans, sequence length up to 4k for long claims, peak throughput ~30 req/s. Will provide DPA/BAA.

olivia_privsec: Important: confirm BAA signed and that PHI never leaves their private deployment. Private deployment + KMS integration required. Also ask legal about retention window and admin access controls.

ai_safety: We'll run targeted safety evals (hallucination on PHI, over-redaction, label leakage). Please upload 500 example docs + 50 adversarial cases. I'll prepare the test matrix and rubric.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: CB-4921 ProdBridge NER onboard (private). Assignee: @raj_se. ETA: initial infra prep 3 business days.

raj_se: Rolling plan: 1) infra + VPC peering 2) ingestion pipeline (S3 -> batch fine-tune) 3) canary model + evals. Need sample of data schema and a small dev token for integration.

maria_cs: I've asked customer for sample schema + DPA. Scheduling enablement call Tue 10am PT. @olivia_privsec can you join for PHI walk-through? @ai_safety to share eval checklist beforehand.

olivia_privsec: :thumbsup: I'll join. Also ask them for contact in legal and whether they require HSM-backed KMS.

ai_safety: Checklist posted: https://redwood-internal/safety/checklists/prodbridge-ner — includes prompt set, privacy checks, failure modes. We'll want the prompt rubric + expected label classes (e.g., POLICY_CODE, CLAIMANT_NAME, MEDICAL_NOTES).

raj_se: Sample ingestion config (for reference):
```
model: custom-ner-prodbridge
sequence_length: 4096
batch_size: auto
quantization: none
```
We'll iterate after data review.

maria_cs: Noted. Renewal risk: customer hinted at enterprise discount tied to go-live by end of quarter — flagging for AM and sales.

ai_safety: I'll queue the evals once we have the 500 docs. Also will run label-leakage checks and adversarial prompts for over-redaction.

maria_cs: Thanks team. I'll update this thread after the enablement call and once we confirm DPA.
